LESSON: FOOD NUTRIENTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes 2.1 Growing Vegetables 9
Topic 2.4: Food Nutrients

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Food Nutrients
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Food Nutrients
2. give Kenyan examples of Food Nutrients
3. practise a safe skill for Food Nutrients

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Food Nutrients

Teach
• Observe Food Nutrients in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Food Nutrients (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Food Nutrients.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Food Nutrients.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Food Nutrients.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Food Nutrients.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Food Nutrients: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Food Nutrients with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
